name: Weather Site Notice
description: One site-specific notice attached to a Severe Weather Warning record: the calm per-asset line for a registered Weather Vulnerable Site in the warning's grid cell. Written by warnings_engine/sites.py on every active warning upsert (engine-owned - do not edit rows by hand); served alongside the parent warning by get_weather_warnings (marked kind=site_notice) and live exactly as long as the parent warning is active. headline/message are exact end-user strings - heads-up possibility phrasing only, never official warning taxonomy. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Event Class
fields.description: Mirror of the parent warning's event class, for list/report filtering

fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: Snapshot of the site's name at generation time

fields.label: Severity (internal enum)
fields.description: Machine identifier only - clients render the wording-based label/strings, never this value. Site notices exist at heads_up and above only (no advisory tier)
